slides.title: Obstacle Avoidance (Local Path Planning)

visualInspection.notes: Local avoidance uses recent local map, runs alongside global planner, and must consider global goal, speed/kinematics, sensor limitations and present/future collision risk. 'Should remain optimal' is a design objective, not a guarantee of global optimality. Actual full 1800-pixel page and footer viewed.

slides.title: Vector Field Histogram (VFH)

visualInspection.notes: Valleys are contiguous below-threshold angular sectors; narrow feasible valley center, wider valley goal-biased interior, temporary alternate detour if goal sector blocked. Angular width alone does not establish physical clearance without range/robot size; no free candidate requires a stop/replan policy, not driving through blockage. visualInspection.notes: Actual arrows show blue attractive field toward G, red repulsion away from obstacle, black combined motion arrow. Artificial fields are computational control constructs, not literal external forces guaranteed to move joints independently; implementation needs joint mapping/constraints. visualInspection.notes: Attraction/repulsion superposition, finite repulsive influence radius, whole-link evaluation. Source mixes scalar potential with force magnitude; force is negative gradient. Farther means stronger attraction only for chosen potential forms such as quadratic, not all potentials. Actual full 1800-pixel page and footer viewed.

slides.title: Challenges of Manipulator Obstacle Avoidance

visualInspection.notes: Six independent DOF→six-dimensional configuration space; grid representation grows exponentially with dimensions. Force cancellation away from goal can stall but stationary point is not necessarily a local minimum without curvature. Self-collision, moving C-obstacles and all-link checking remain distinct challenges. Actual full 1800-pixel page and footer viewed.
